mentions.text:
DIGITIMES: As AI server shipments continue to grow, not only advanced packaging but even traditional packaging is expected to face supply shortages.

In particular, wire bonding equipment used in traditional packaging is becoming increasingly tight. The market is dominated by Kulicke & Soffa (K&S) and ASMPT, whose tools are also extremely difficult to replace.

We are now in the unexpected situation where even traditional packaging capacity has to be secured early through upfront cash commitments and established business relationships.

reasons: wire bonding equipment emerging as the primary bottleneck
